Complete measured cost and resource review followed by action-specific source-bound authority; no imported historical grant.

source_correct_enrollment.required: Before candidate outputs, capture complete exact-policy baselines and freeze Sparse-correct preservation plus Supa-correct/Sparse-wrong recovery parents. Gold alone is not baseline competence. Preserve individual harms, repairs, incompletes and parent dependence.

future_pruning_opposition.inherited_delta_rule: Add each transformed NEW delta once to the immediate Sparse parent; do not double-add inherited Titan/Sparse updates or treat raw LoRA A/B factors as full deltas.
future_pruning_opposition.if_owner_keeps_LoRA: Effective full-weight materialization and the control frame need their own explicit registration; the dense-joint proposal cannot be assumed.

historical_lead.limits: One null longcontext draw, arithmetic regressions, spent report-only retention instruments; neither universal quality gain nor no forgetting.
